panels.scene: Dana walking on a city sidewalk with a phone at her ear and a small rolling suitcase, brisk and cheerful. Top third plain sky.
dialogue: I land at four. Who's picking me up?

panels.scene: Walt at a diner counter with a folded newspaper and coffee, phone at his ear, amused. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: Me. I'll be the one with the beard.

panels.scene: Walt standing beside his car at a curb, giving Dana a hug, her suitcase beside them, both smiling. Top third plain sky, no signs anywhere.
panels.caption: After that, just time together.
